from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import MessageTextInput, IntInput, Output
from langflow.schema import Message

import chromadb
import requests
from pathlib import Path


class CielMemorySearch(Component):
    display_name = "Ciel Memory Search"
    description = "Mencari long-term memory secara semantic menggunakan Ollama dan Chroma."
    icon = "search"

    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(
            name="search_query",
            display_name="Search Query",
            info="Pertanyaan atau konteks yang ingin dicari dari long-term memory.",
            tool_mode=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="top_k",
            display_name="Top K",
            info="Jumlah memory paling relevan yang dikembalikan.",
            value=5,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(
            name="result",
            display_name="Memory Results",
            method="search_memory",
            types=["Message"],
        ),
    ]

    def search_memory(self) -> Message:
        query = (self.search_query or "").strip()

        if not query:
            raise ValueError("Search Query tidak boleh kosong.")

        # ==========================================
        # KONFIGURASI
        # ==========================================
        ollama_url = "http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/embed"
        embedding_model = "nomic-embed-text-v2-moe:latest"

        db_path = Path.home() / ".ciel_ai" / "long_term_memory"
        collection_name = "ciel_long_term_memory"

        # ==========================================
        # 1. EMBEDDING QUERY
        # ==========================================
        try:
            response = requests.post(
                ollama_url,
                json={
                    "model": embedding_model,
                    "input": query,
                },
                timeout=120,
            )
        except requests.RequestException as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Gagal menghubungi Ollama: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if response.status_code != 200:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Ollama embedding gagal.\n"
                f"Status: {response.status_code}\n"
                f"Response: {response.text}"
            )

        data = response.json()

        try:
            query_embedding = data["embeddings"][0]
        except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Response embedding Ollama tidak sesuai:\n{data}"
            ) from exc

        # ==========================================
        # 2. BUKA CHROMA
        # ==========================================
        try:
            client = chromadb.PersistentClient(
                path=str(db_path)
            )

            collection = client.get_collection(
                name=collection_name
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Gagal membuka memory collection:\n{exc}"
            ) from exc

        # ==========================================
        # 3. CEK APAKAH ADA MEMORY
        # ==========================================
        total = collection.count()

        if total == 0:
            return Message(
                text="Belum ada memory yang tersimpan."
            )

        # Jangan meminta lebih banyak hasil dari jumlah memory
        k = max(1, min(int(self.top_k), total))

        # ==========================================
        # 4. SEMANTIC SEARCH
        # ==========================================
        try:
            results = collection.query(
                query_embeddings=[query_embedding],
                n_results=k,
                include=["documents", "metadatas", "distances"],
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Gagal melakukan pencarian memory:\n{exc}"
            ) from exc

        documents = results.get("documents", [[]])[0]
        metadatas = results.get("metadatas", [[]])[0]
        distances = results.get("distances", [[]])[0]

        # ==========================================
        # 5. FORMAT HASIL
        # ==========================================
        lines = [
            "HASIL LONG-TERM MEMORY",
            "",
        ]

        for i, document in enumerate(documents, start=1):
            lines.append(f"[Memory {i}]")
            lines.append(f"Isi: {document}")
            lines.append("")

        return Message(text="\n".join(lines))

from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import MessageTextInput, Output
from langflow.schema import Message

import chromadb
import requests
import uuid
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone


class CielMemoryStore(Component):
    display_name = "Ciel Memory Store"
    description = "Menyimpan informasi jangka panjang ke Chroma lokal menggunakan embedding Ollama."
    icon = "database"

    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(
            name="memory_text",
            display_name="Memory Text",
            info="Informasi yang ingin disimpan ke long-term memory.",
            tool_mode=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(
            name="result",
            display_name="Memory Result",
            method="save_memory",
        ),
    ]

    def save_memory(self) -> Message:
        text = (self.memory_text or "").strip()

        if not text:
            raise ValueError("Memory Text tidak boleh kosong.")

        # ==============================
        # KONFIGURASI
        # ==============================
        ollama_url = "http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/embed"
        embedding_model = "nomic-embed-text-v2-moe:latest"

        db_path = Path.home() / ".ciel_ai" / "long_term_memory"
        db_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        collection_name = "ciel_long_term_memory"

        # ==============================
        # 1. EMBEDDING OLLAMA
        # ==============================
        try:
            response = requests.post(
                ollama_url,
                json={
                    "model": embedding_model,
                    "input": text,
                },
                timeout=120,
            )
        except requests.RequestException as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Gagal menghubungi Ollama: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if response.status_code != 200:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Ollama embedding gagal.\n"
                f"Status: {response.status_code}\n"
                f"Response: {response.text}"
            )

        data = response.json()

        try:
            embedding = data["embeddings"][0]
        except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Response embedding Ollama tidak sesuai:\n{data}"
            ) from exc

        # ==============================
        # 2. CHROMA PERSISTENT
        # ==============================
        try:
            client = chromadb.PersistentClient(
                path=str(db_path)
            )

            collection = client.get_or_create_collection(
                name=collection_name,
                metadata={"hnsw:space": "cosine"},
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Gagal membuka Chroma:\n{exc}"
            ) from exc

        # ==============================
        # 3. SIMPAN MEMORY
        # ==============================
        memory_id = f"memory_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
        timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

        try:
            collection.add(
                ids=[memory_id],
                embeddings=[embedding],
                documents=[text],
                metadatas=[
                    {
                        "created_at": timestamp,
                        "source": "ciel_memory_engine",
                    }
                ],
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Gagal menyimpan memory ke Chroma:\n{exc}"
            ) from exc

        count = collection.count()

        # ==============================
        # 4. OUTPUT MESSAGE
        # ==============================
        return Message(
            text=(
                "Memory berhasil disimpan.\n\n"
                f"ID: {memory_id}\n"
                f"Total memory: {count}\n"
                f"Database: {db_path}"
            )
        )
